name: Intercontinental Presidente Cozumel Resort
positioning: Beachfront resort on Cozumel's southern hotel zone, officially InterContinental Presidente Cozumel Resort Spa, with an on-site dive center, an infinity pool facing the Caribbean and Ikal Spa, where Mayan rituals meet advanced therapies
best_for: Divers and snorkellers who want an on-site dive center and dive packages
Families wanting a complimentary kids club for ages 5 to 12
Spa-goers drawn to a shaman-guided temazcal ritual

facts.text: The resort is at Km 6.5 on the Carretera a Chankanaab in Cozumel's southern hotel zone, Quintana Roo, Mexico.
The resort overlooks the white sands and clear waters of Cozumel.
Guests can take in panoramic views of the Caribbean from their room.
The hotel's dive packages are with Scuba Du, whose trips are led by PADI-certified instructors.
Scuba Du dives take in walls, shipwrecks, coral formations and marine life.
Ikal Spa has a jacuzzi, cold plunge pool, sauna, steam room, beauty salon and temazcal.
The Reef Suite may include an outdoor private pool and beach access.
Premium Rooms may include an outdoor shower and beach or pool access.
Le Cap Beach Club is a beachside restaurant serving contemporary Mediterranean cuisine with fresh seafood and wood-fired dishes.
Faro Blanco restaurant looks over the hotel's private cove.
Planet Trekkers is a complimentary kids club for ages 5 to 12, with daily activities about Mexican history and culture.
Cozumel International Airport (CZM) is about 4 kilometers (2.49 miles) from the hotel.

highlights.text: The resort has an on-site dive center for exploring the island's coral reefs and marine life.
Ikal Spa combines Mayan rituals with advanced therapies.
The spa's temazcal offers a purification ritual guided by a shaman.
The infinity pool has views of the Caribbean Sea that blend with the horizon.
The Presidential Sapphire Suite may include an outdoor private pool, ocean view and beach access.

considerations.text: Sargassum seaweed is a natural occurrence and may occasionally appear on the beach despite active cleaning.
WhataHotel notes the island location requires a ferry or flight transfer from the mainland.
WhataHotel notes hurricane season may affect travel plans during the summer months.
